text:
kate-mkt: Quick brainstorm — HackStarter Snacklets: a 4-week micro-series (3 micro-tutorials + 1 mini OSS refapp each month). each piece = 2min read, runnable Docker refapp, tiny benchmark card. low-friction. thoughts? :sparkles:
devrel-ryn: big yes. keep CTA as "Run in 5". refapps should be single-file + minimal deps. endpoints: /health and /invoke. include a Replit play button or one-click Docker snippet.
sam-eng: agree on the three-profile bench: hosted-small, dedicated-default, private-quantized. i'll script a 256-token workload runner. metrics: p50, p95, and cost per 1k tokens. will produce a CSV artifact.
tom-ops: inbound flow: blog microform capturing use-case, team size, and demo interest. enterprise -> CRM webhook; community -> Slack #community-inbound. recommend secret-scan in CI and mask artifacts.
claire-ux: visuals: compact benchmark card (p50 / p95 / cost/1k) + 6s GIF template showing request -> response. i'll provide two hero variants for A/B.
sales-ivy: gating idea: keep main posts ungated, offer optional gated demo for enterprise leads (short form -> AE). capture timezone for office hours invites.
devrel-ryn: distribution plan: blog post + 4-tweet thread + short 45s demo clip + pinned GH issue. encourage community PRs with label "hackstarter-contrib" and a CONTRIBUTING.md.
kate-mkt: timeline proposal: week0 scaffold + baseline bench; week1 Snack #1 publish; week2 Snack #2 + 30m office hours; week3 Snack #3 + roundup + community picks. pilot = 4 weeks.
sam-eng: i'll add a small GH Action: lint -> build image -> run bench -> publish CSV artifact on release. include a guard to prevent keys in logs.
devrel-ryn: content checklist for each snack: 1) 2-min explainer, 2) copy-paste code snippet, 3) screenshot/GIF, 4) benchmark card, 5) link to refapp repo, 6) contributor credit.
kate-mkt: quick run snippet we'll include in posts:
```bash
# build & run locally
docker build -t hackstarter-ref .
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx -p 8080:8080 hackstarter-ref
```
tom-ops: CI/ops notes: enable secret-scan, set artifact retention to 30 days, redact keys in published CSVs. also add a tiny security callout in the post: "don't commit keys".
kate-mkt: good. i'll draft Snack #1 ("Tiny reranker in 5") today and open the starter repo. assign: devrel-ryn (content + office hours), sam-eng (bench + action), claire-ux (visuals), tom-ops (inbound + ops). will reconvene after initial scaffold. :rocket:
